title: About Koyome
desc: What this little site is for.
body:
This can be considered a summary of my 20-year-old self. Over these years, I have experienced many things—partings, joys, and pains.But I still appreciate everything that has happened, whether good or bad—I find it all meaningful.
Here, I would like to express my gratitude to my closest friends. Perhaps I have unilaterally deemed them as such, but I am deeply thankful for your companionship and the support you have given me! This comes from the heart. So, who are my closest friends? I won't say much more. The most representative example is someone named Bo Bo (pseudonym). We've had a continuous interaction on Douyin for nearly 800 days. He is an exceptionally capable and kind person who always offers guidance and companionship when I'm troubled or feeling down. Meeting him truly has been a wonderful experience in life! Of course, there are many good friends like Hyl, with whom I play sports together; WZR, with whom I chat occasionally; and XY, a great brother in GTA... and so on. In short, this is essentially all of my life. So I want to say it again: meeting you all has truly been the best thing in my life!
Those who have hurt me in the past—whatever they did—can be considered part of the past now. If you can see this, I don't mind at all. Your presence is also the meaning in my life.So, it's no big deal.
In short, this is all I have. For the road ahead, I must bring my true capabilities to bear and keep moving forward!
bodyZh:
算是對我20歲的一個總結吧，這些年來我經歷了很多，有離別有開心有痛苦。但我仍然感謝發生的一切，無論是好還是壞，我都覺得很有意義。也有人會說你做這些有啥用有什麼意義不就是想裝逼？我想說的是做什麼事從來不需要它能起什麼作用，熱愛就是所有的理由和答案。比起嘲諷他人質問他人不如做自己喜歡的事。
在這我要跟我的摯友道謝，也許是我擅自認為的摯友，但我非常感謝你們的陪伴和給我的支持！這是發自內心的，那麼摯友有哪些呢？我就不多說了，最有代表的是一個叫波波（化名）的吧，抖音跟他快800多天的火花了，他是一個很厲害也很善良的人，總在我困擾的時候難過的時候提點我陪著我，能遇到他真是人生的一件美事！當然還有很多好朋友像一起打球的hyl，偶爾聊天的wzr，Gta裡的好哥哥xy..等等，總之這大概就是我生活的全部了，所以我想再說一次：遇見你們真是我人生中最好的事！
以前傷害過我的人，怎麼說都也算是過去了吧，如果你們能看到這，我也無所謂了，你們的出現也是我人生中的意義。所以也沒什麼大不了的。
 總之這就是我的全部了，接下來的路也要拿出真本事走下去！
